generation_policy: Contract-gated: generated only for previously uncovered L2 features with a nonblank L2 what contract; contract contents are treated as provisionally correct per user instruction.

feature.description: Declare local and remote execution hosts, host types, addresses, lifecycle settings, heartbeat and probe rules, and capacity or concurrency limits, and expose the validated cluster topology to operator binding and scheduling.

contract.purpose_user_function: Register physical actor hosts and local/remote execution surfaces, validate host metadata, discover or probe peers, bind actors/operators to hosts, and expose capacity/availability to routing and scheduling.
contract.valid_inputs: Actor-host registry entries with host_id/type, address/carrier metadata, lifecycle, heartbeat and probe configuration; remote dispatch target/config; HIVE node identity/capabilities; concurrency policies.
contract.expected_outputs: Validated host registry/topology, peer/host status, heartbeat/probe state, operator-host bindings, remote dispatch result, capacity/concurrency decisions, and degraded/offline errors.
contract.state_side_effects: Can update host heartbeat/probe/lifecycle state, start HIVE discovery/P2P services, create remote dispatch artifacts/processes, and allocate/release operator leases subject to policy.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: Schema-invalid host records fail validation; offline/stale/failed-probe hosts are unavailable; remote command/transport failures return explicit errors; concurrency and quota blocks prevent assignment.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: actor-hosts.json contains documentation/stub hosts and must not be treated as live topology without probes. HIVE is documented as Phase 2 discovery/communication, not a fully proven production cluster manager.
contract.success_evidence: harness/config/actor-hosts.schema.json and actor-hosts.json; core/hive/README.md and core/hive/QUICKSTART.md; tests/harness/remote/test_remote_dispatch_core.py; tests/harness/remote/test_remote_dispatch_cli.py. The former remote-dispatch report wrapper is quarantined because it writes into a pre-existing runtime and is not accepted evidence.
contract.granularity_atomic_contracts: Host type/address validation; local versus SSH/managed/tmux host; heartbeat fresh/stale; probe pass/fail; offline/degraded lifecycle; actor binding; concurrency available/exhausted; peer discovery; remote dispatch success/failure; stub topology not live.
